fc.adsHint.en: Review each angle and opening. Choose the ads you want in this test.
fc.adsHint.zh: 对比各条素材的创意与开场，选择本轮想测试的广告。

fc.adsArchiveHint.en: The ads selected for this round. Approved versions cannot change.
fc.adsArchiveHint.zh: 查看本轮广告记录。已批准版本不可更改。

fc.copyDetails.zh: 查看文案、说明与修订记录

fc.approverNeeded.en: An approver must approve the ads and submit the launch. Reviewers can choose ads and request changes.
fc.approverNeeded.zh: 批准广告和提交投放需要审批角色。审阅者可以选择广告或要求修改。

fc.approveBudgetFirst.en: Approve this round’s budget before submitting the launch.
fc.approveBudgetFirst.zh: 提交投放前，请先批准本轮预算。

fc.roundScale.en: Scale the winning ad: “{hypothesis}”. Same audience; 3× the first budget.
fc.roundScale.zh: 加大胜出广告“{hypothesis}”的测试。受众不变，预算为首轮的 3 倍。

fc.roundMore.en: Create more ads based on the winner: “{hypothesis}”. Same audience and budget.
fc.roundMore.zh: 根据胜出广告“{hypothesis}”制作更多广告。受众和预算不变。

fc.roundRetry.en: Create new ads after a round with no ad above both benchmarks. Same audience and budget.
fc.roundRetry.zh: 本轮没有广告同时超过两项基准，制作新广告继续测试。受众和预算不变。
